## Zillow Group, Inc. Class A (ZG) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Zillow Group Class A (ZG) rose 11.70% on Thursday, October 15, 2026, while Zillow (Z), Opendoor and Compass also advanced; Zillow and Compass gained about 8%, and Opendoor gained 9% as the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 5.1%, lowering expected mortgage costs. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; 15:51 ET) [4]
- Zillow Group (ZG) traded near $31.40 during Thursday’s session, while Opendoor rose 9% and Compass rose 6%; the report attributed the housing-stock rally to the retreat in long-term Treasury yields. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; 15:51 ET) [4]
- Zillow’s September rental-market analysis reported rental demand up 19.2% year over year, typical monthly rent at $1,932, up 2.7%, and the typical new-homeowner monthly payment at $3,037, up 5%; Zillow senior economist Kara Ng said elevated mortgage rates were pushing home shoppers toward rentals. (StockTitan, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated) [9]
- A Bernstein report maintained a Hold rating on Zillow Group Class A and a $38 price target; the report was released October 14 and updated October 15. (The Globe and Mail, Oct 14, 2026; publish time not stated) [10]
- MarketBeat reported Zillow shares up 7.5% to approximately $31.47 on October 15 and cited a consensus Hold rating with an average price target of $51.19; the article did not identify a new October 15 analyst action as the cause. (MarketBeat, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated) [1]
- Zillow Group’s latest reported quarter showed EPS of $0.52 versus a $0.44 consensus estimate and revenue of $772 million versus a $758.25 million consensus estimate; the results were released August 5, 2026, outside the requested window. (MarketBeat, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated) [1]
- No after-hours or pre-market catalyst for ZG before 02:03 ET on Friday, October 16, 2026 was identified in the available results.
